{"metadata":{"description":"Codex-style permanent git worktrees for DeepSeek Harness: worktree_create/list/remove agent tools, a /worktree chat command, and durable per-repo manifests.","id":"gh:1333176506","install_available":false,"language":"JavaScript","name":"dsh-worktree","slug":"FlashingChen/dsh-worktree","topics":["deepseek-harness","dsh","dsh-plugin","git","plugin","worktree"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"Codex-style permanent git worktrees for DeepSeek Harness: worktree_create/list/remove agent tools, a"},{"id":"p1s2","text":" /worktree chat command, and durable per-repo manifests."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-worktree"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"English | 中文"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"Codex-style **permanent git worktrees** for DeepSeek Harness — a Cordis
plugin that gives a DSH prof"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"ile the same durable-worktree workflow as
`codex worktree create --permanent`."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"A permanent worktree is a real `git worktree add --detach` checkout that
**survives sessions and res"},{"id":"p5s2","text":"tarts**. You (or the agent) create it once, and
any later session can be opened inside it to keep wo"},{"id":"p5s3","text":"rking where the previous
one left off — without ever touching your main working tree."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"## What you get"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"| Codex CLI | dsh-worktree equivalent |"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"| `codex worktree create --permanent <name> [<base>]` | agent tool `worktree_create`, or `/worktree "},{"id":"p8s2","text":"create <name> [<base>]` |
| `codex worktree list` | agent tool `worktree_list`, or `/worktree` / `/w"},{"id":"p8s3","text":"orktree list` |
| `codex worktree open <name>` | `/worktree open <name>` (registers the worktree as "},{"id":"p8s4","text":"a DSH workspace; start a new session there) |
| `codex worktree close/delete <name>` | agent tool `w"},{"id":"p8s5","text":"orktree_remove`, or `/worktree remove <name>` |
| worktree shown in session context | one-shot conte"},{"id":"p8s6","text":"xt note when a session runs inside a registered worktree |"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"On top of the CLI parity, the model itself gets the tools, so it can fork
its own permanent workspac"},{"id":"p9s2","text":"e mid-task — create a worktree at a specific
commit, work there with the normal file tools, and clea"},{"id":"p9s3","text":"ate a worktree at a specific
commit, work there with the normal file tools, and clean up afterwards."},{"id":"p10s1","text":"## How it works"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"- Worktrees live at `<repo-root>/.dsh-worktrees/<name>` — the same hidden
directory pattern as Codex"},{"id":"p11s2","text":"'s `.codex/worktrees/` — so they stay inside the
repository (and, when the session workspace is the "},{"id":"p11s3","text":"repo root, inside the
session's `workspace-write` sandbox).
- Every worktree is recorded in a per-re"},{"id":"p11s4","text":"pository manifest,
`<repo-root>/.dsh-worktrees/manifest.json` (name, path, base commit,
created-at, "},{"id":"p11s5","text":"creator session). The manifest is what makes worktrees
**permanent**: they survive DSH restarts, are"},{"id":"p11s6","text":" listed by the tools/command,
and are recognized when a new session is opened inside one.
- Creating"},{"id":"p11s7","text":" a worktree also registers it in `ctx.workspaceRegistry`, so it
appears in the DSH workspace list — "},{"id":"p11s8","text":"the native way to "open" it later.
- Removing a worktree runs `git worktree remove` (with `--force` "},{"id":"p11s9","text":"when
requested), deletes the manifest entry, and unregisters the workspace.
It refuses to remove the"},{"id":"p11s10","text":" worktree the current session is running inside."},{"id":"p12s1","text":"## Requirements"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"- git ≥ 2.31 (uses `git rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-common-dir`).
- A DSH profile with th"},{"id":"p13s2","text":"e `tools`, `commands`, and `subprocess` services
(the `web` profile has all three via `dsh-base`)."},{"id":"p14s1","text":"## Installation"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"Installing from source (development, or to match a different harness version):"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"> The plugin's dependencies are pinned to the harness versions it was built
> against (`@deepseek-ai"},{"id":"p18s2","text":"/* 0.1.0-rc.6`). If your DSH installation is a
> different version, install from source and run `npm"},{"id":"p18s3","text":" install <matching
> versions>` in the plugin directory (or adjust `package.json`) so the
> plugin l"},{"id":"p18s4","text":"oads against your harness."},{"id":"p19s1","text":"Configuration (all optional):"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"## Usage"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"### Agent tools"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"- `worktree_create {name, baseCommit?}` — create a permanent detached
worktree of the repository con"},{"id":"p23s2","text":"taining the current session (default base:
current HEAD). Returns the worktree path, repo root, and "},{"id":"p23s3","text":"base commit.
- `worktree_list` — list registered worktrees with live git state
(exists, HEAD, branch"},{"id":"p23s4","text":").
- `worktree_remove {name, force?}` — remove a registered worktree
(`--force` also discards uncomm"},{"id":"p23s5","text":"itted changes). Refuses to remove the
worktree the current session is working inside."},{"id":"p24s1","text":"### Chat command"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"### Session context"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"When a session's workspace is inside a registered permanent worktree, the
agent is told once: which "},{"id":"p27s2","text":"worktree, of which repo, at which base commit,
plus the management commands."},{"id":"p28s1","text":"## Sandbox note"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"The git operations run through DSH's own `ctx.subprocess` seam (not the
agent bash tool), like other"},{"id":"p29s2","text":" harness-managed processes. With the default
`workspace-write` permission mode, worktree files are w"},{"id":"p29s3","text":"ritable by the agent
when the worktree lives under the session's workspace root — which is the
case "},{"id":"p29s4","text":"whenever the session was started at the repository root (the normal
setup). If a session starts from"},{"id":"p29s5","text":" a subdirectory of the repo, `.dsh-worktrees`
lands outside that session's workspace; open a new ses"},{"id":"p29s6","text":"sion with the worktree
as its workspace to work inside it."},{"id":"p30s1","text":"## Development"},{"id":"p31s1","text":"- `node test/smoke.js` — standalone end-to-end test of the git logic against
a scratch repository (n"},{"id":"p31s2","text":"o DSH boot needed).
- Activation check: boot a minimal cordis tree
(`system-prompt`, `tools`, `comma"},{"id":"p31s3","text":"nds`, `subprocess`, `dsh-worktree`) from
the profile's node_modules and assert registration + a real"},{"id":"p31s4","text":"
create/list/remove round trip."},{"id":"p32s1","text":"## Layout"},{"id":"p33s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p34s1","text":"## License"},{"id":"p35s1","text":"MIT — see LICENSE."}],"truncated":false}
